name: Furry Roll
tagline: Roll the dice. Meet your fursona.
blurb: Throw ten dice to build a one-of-a-kind fluffy 3D fursona part by part, catch it in a Cosy Box, collect 100 species in the Furrydex, dress it up in the Photo Studio and hatch eggs in the Furry Nest. No ads, and nothing you can buy changes the dice.
